ToolsSection.title: What is STEMify?
ToolsSection.description: In this video, discover how STEMify addresses the gap in 21st-century skills education with hands-on STEAM and STEM solutions. We support teachers to build the innovators of tomorrow by fostering creativity, coding, and rapid prototyping. With accessible tools and free digital and offline resources, students of all abilities can explore and develop essential skills for the future.
